description: Question model added to Prisma schema
steps: Open prisma/schema.prisma
Verify Question model exists with fields: id, userId, contentId, contentType, question, answer, status, askedAt
Verify relations to User model
Run npx prisma validate to confirm schema is valid
Run npx prisma generate to confirm client generates successfully

description: ABTest and ABTestAssignment models added to Prisma schema
steps: Open prisma/schema.prisma
Verify ABTest model exists with fields: id, name, contentType, variants (JSON), startDate, endDate, status, tenantId, createdAt
Verify ABTestAssignment model exists with fields: id, testId, userId, variant, assignedAt
Verify relations between ABTest, ABTestAssignment, User, and Tenant
Run npx prisma validate to confirm schema is valid
Run npx prisma generate to confirm client generates successfully

description: Database migration applies cleanly for Sprint 6 models
steps: Run npm run db:push to apply schema changes
Verify no errors during migration
Verify Question, ABTest, and ABTestAssignment tables exist in database

description: Q&A generator produces RAG-powered answers with citations
steps: Verify lib/qa/generator.ts exists
Verify generateAnswer() function accepts a question string, contentId, contentType, and userId
Verify it performs RAG search via Azure AI Search to retrieve relevant context
Verify it calls Azure OpenAI to generate an answer using retrieved context
Verify the response includes the answer text, citations array, and confidence score
Verify citations reference actual source documents from the RAG search results

description: Q&A guardrails detect prohibited questions and validate answers
steps: Verify lib/qa/guardrails.ts exists
Verify validateQuestion() screens for prohibited question types (specific investment advice, account details, PII requests)
Verify validateAnswer() checks that answers contain required disclaimers and no prohibited claims
Verify escalateToAdvisor() flags complex or high-risk questions for advisor review
Verify a prohibited question returns a rejection response with reason
Verify a valid question passes guardrails and proceeds to answer generation

description: Q&A API endpoint accepts questions and returns answers
steps: Verify app/api/qa/route.ts exists with POST handler
Submit a POST request with a question, contentId, and contentType
Verify the response includes answer text, citations, and confidence score
Verify unauthenticated requests return 401
Verify the question and answer are persisted to the Question table in the database
Verify the question status is set appropriately (answered, escalated, or rejected)

description: Q&A API returns question history for a user
steps: Verify app/api/qa/route.ts has a GET handler
Submit a GET request with optional contentId filter
Verify it returns a list of past questions and answers for the authenticated user
Verify questions are ordered by askedAt descending (most recent first)
Verify unauthenticated requests return 401

description: Q&A chat interface renders on content pages
steps: Verify components/qa/QAInterface.tsx exists
Navigate to a briefing detail page
Verify a Q&A section or expandable panel is visible
Verify the interface includes a text input for asking questions
Verify the interface includes a submit button
Verify the interface displays a placeholder or welcome message when no questions have been asked

description: Q&A interface displays answers with citations
steps: Navigate to a content page with the Q&A interface
Type a question in the input field and submit
Verify a loading/thinking indicator appears while the answer generates
Verify the answer text is displayed in a chat-like bubble or card
Verify citations are displayed below or alongside the answer with source names
Verify the confidence score is shown (e.g., as a badge or indicator)

description: Q&A interface shows question history for current content
steps: Navigate to a content page where questions have been previously asked
Verify past questions and answers are displayed in chronological order
Verify each Q&A pair shows the question, answer, citations, and timestamp
Verify new questions appear at the bottom of the conversation thread

description: Q&A guardrails show user-friendly rejection messages
steps: Navigate to the Q&A interface on a content page
Submit a question that would be prohibited (e.g., 'Should I buy this stock?')
Verify the interface displays a polite rejection message explaining why the question can't be answered
Verify the rejection includes a suggestion to contact their advisor for personalized advice
Verify the rejected question still appears in the conversation history with its status

description: Q&A escalation flags questions for advisor review
steps: Submit a question that triggers escalation (complex or high-risk topic)
Verify the question status is set to 'escalated' in the database
Verify the user receives a message indicating their question has been sent to an advisor
Verify escalated questions appear in the advisor review queue or a dedicated Q&A review section

description: A/B testing framework supports variant assignment
steps: Verify lib/testing/ab-testing.ts exists
Verify createTest() can create an A/B test with name, content type, variants, and date range
Verify assignVariant() deterministically assigns a user to a variant (consistent on repeated calls)
Verify getAssignment() retrieves a user's existing variant assignment for a test
Verify variant assignment is persisted to ABTestAssignment table

description: A/B testing framework calculates statistical significance
steps: Verify lib/testing/ab-testing.ts includes a calculateSignificance() function
Verify it accepts engagement metrics for each variant (e.g., open rate, completion rate, dwell time)
Verify it returns a p-value or confidence level for the difference between variants
Verify it correctly identifies when results are statistically significant (p < 0.05)
Verify it handles edge cases: zero events, single variant, identical metrics

description: Content variant generation produces different content formats
steps: Verify lib/testing/variants.ts exists
Verify generateVariants() can produce different content variations for a given piece of content
Verify variants can differ by format (e.g., concise vs detailed, text vs bullet points)
Verify each variant is tagged with a variant identifier for tracking
Verify variant metadata is stored for later analysis

description: A/B test management API supports CRUD operations
steps: Verify app/api/testing/route.ts exists
Submit a POST request to create a new A/B test with name, variants, and date range
Verify the test is persisted to the ABTest table
Submit a GET request to list all A/B tests for the tenant
Verify tests are returned with their status (draft, active, completed)
Verify only advisor-role users can create and manage tests
Verify unauthenticated requests return 401

description: A/B test results API returns variant performance metrics
steps: Verify app/api/testing/[testId]/results/route.ts exists (or equivalent endpoint)
Submit a GET request with a test ID
Verify the response includes per-variant metrics: open rate, completion rate, avg dwell time, avg rating
Verify the response includes statistical significance calculation
Verify the response includes sample sizes per variant
Verify only advisor-role users can access test results

description: A/B test management page allows creating and viewing tests
steps: Navigate to /testing as an advisor user
Verify the page loads with a list of existing A/B tests (or empty state)
Click a 'Create Test' button
Fill in test name, select content type, define variant names, set start and end dates
Submit the form and verify the new test appears in the list
Verify each test in the list shows name, status, date range, and participant count

description: A/B test results page shows variant performance comparison
steps: Navigate to /testing as an advisor user
Click on an existing A/B test to view its results
Verify a comparison view shows metrics for each variant side by side
Verify engagement metrics are displayed: open rate, completion rate, dwell time, rating
Verify statistical significance indicator is shown (e.g., 'Significant' or 'Not yet significant')
Verify sample sizes are displayed for each variant

description: A/B testing page is accessible from advisor navigation
steps: Sign in as an advisor user
Verify a 'Testing' or 'A/B Testing' link appears in the navigation header
Click the navigation link
Verify it navigates to the /testing page
Verify the link is NOT visible for non-advisor (family_member/trustee) users

description: A/B test variant assignment integrates with content delivery
steps: Create an active A/B test for briefings
Verify that when a client user views a briefing, they are assigned a variant
Verify the variant assignment is recorded in ABTestAssignment
Verify the same user consistently receives the same variant for the same test
Verify analytics events for the content include the variant identifier

description: Enhanced confidence scoring for citations
steps: Verify lib/compliance/confidence-scoring.ts exists
Verify calculateConfidence() evaluates source reliability, recency, and relevance
Verify confidence thresholds are enforced (content below threshold is flagged)
Verify low-confidence content is automatically routed for advisor review
Verify confidence scores are persisted with citations in the database

description: Q&A engagement events are tracked in analytics
steps: Ask a question through the Q&A interface
Verify a 'qa_question' analytics event is recorded in the AnalyticsEvent table
Verify the event includes metadata: contentId, contentType, question length
Verify a 'qa_answer' event is recorded when the answer is displayed
Verify Q&A engagement appears in the analytics dashboard metrics

description: Q&A interface is available on explainer and lesson pages (not just briefings)
steps: Navigate to an explainer detail page
Verify the Q&A interface is present and functional
Navigate to a lesson detail page
Verify the Q&A interface is present and functional
Ask a question on each content type and verify answers are returned with correct contentType

description: A/B test lifecycle management (activate, pause, complete)
steps: Create a new A/B test via API (starts in 'draft' status)
Activate the test and verify status changes to 'active'
Pause the test and verify status changes to 'paused' and no new assignments are made
Resume the test and verify it returns to 'active'
Complete the test and verify status changes to 'completed' and results are finalized
Verify completed tests cannot be reactivated

description: Build compiles cleanly with all Sprint 6 changes
steps: Run npx tsc --noEmit to verify TypeScript compiles without errors
Run npm run build to verify the production build succeeds
Run npm run lint to verify no linting errors
